text: Amavasya is the moonless night, a special time to remember those who came before us.
This remembrance is not born of fear, but from a deep understanding: a family that cherishes and remembers its elders knows its roots and its place in the world.
On this day, you may offer water to Surya Bhagavan in the morning.
In the evening, light a deepam at home.
And perhaps, tell someone younger in your family a story about a grandparent they never had the chance to meet.
This simple act of remembrance is a complete observance.
